RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY, except the single prohibition box which carries diagonal hatching.
The Provenance Map block is emphasised with a 2pt border and a light grey backing panel; it is the key technique.
Frozen outputs use a DASHED grey border plus a small [Fixed] pill; NO padlock symbol.
Decision diamond has two labelled branches: Yes continues right as a SOLID arrow, No is a DASHED arrow.
Amber (#E69F00) is used for borders and hatching only, never as text colour.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 8-9pt, notes 7-8pt.
Icons are monochrome thin grey line art. No colored icons.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no drop shadows.
